result.summary: Do not ship: Save Settings now silently resets General settings and discards edits to them.

findings.title: Restore General fields to the Save Settings submission
findings.body: The Save Settings button at lines 241–244 now submits only the instance form; General controls belong to a separate form with no submit button. The unchanged handler at triggarr/web/routes.py:531–539 replaces missing General values with defaults and persists them. For example, saving an instance with hard_max_per_cycle=10 and skip_unreleased=true configured now writes 0 (unlimited) and false, removing the configured cap and release filtering. General edits are also omitted. Previously, explicit form associations included these values in the same submission.
findings.recommendation: Restore the settings-form ID and General controls' form associations. Verify the existing form-association test and add a submission regression check that nondefault General values survive saving instance settings.

next_steps: Restore the shared submission and verify that Save Settings persists General edits without resetting existing values.
